correctness.rationale: Tonchev–Wang states the lower bound and equality condition used to reduce optimality to perfect regular 3+3 systems. The bundled verifier exhaustively checks every disjoint triple pair in Z_19, counts 1482 unordered and 2964 ordered systems, recomputes the complete stated symmetry action, verifies all five orbits and stabilizers, and checks the census digest. The claim is finite and fully exhausted; no timeout or sampled search is used.

value.rationale: The parameter \(n=19\) is the natural \(m=3\) equality case \(n=2m^2+1\) of the binary index-one lower bound. The bundled computation independently shows the preceding \(m=1\) and \(m=2\) equality cases each have a single affine class, whereas \(m=3\) splits into five, including one uniquely symmetric class. Thus the result supplies a natural complete extremal classification and symmetry data, not merely a known optimum value or an arbitrary finite slice.
